text:
marta: Quick draft for tonight's EU canary. Need ops + legal sign-off before internal announce.

marta: RN draft:
"KV-cache: improved warmup (exposes warmup_ms, warmup_hits) -> ~30% fewer cold-start tokens at p95. Model pinned to v2.1.3 for canary; automatic fallback to v2.0.9 if overloaded. SDK: opt-in auth header change behind feature flag. Private EU customers: processing remains in-region per residency config."

devansh: Ops notes: schedule 00:30Z, start at 5% traffic. Rollback triggers: error rate >1.5% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency >1500ms for 3m. Ramp plan: 5% -> 20% after 10m if healthy. I'll wire alerts to canary-errors@pager.

kai: I'll own the ramp and monitoring. Add a short breaking-changes line in RN for SDK leads.

lia: Legal ok with the EU residency sentence. Add it to RN and I'm good to sign.

devansh: Deploy command to run:
```
/deploy canary eu-1 --pin model:v2.1.3 --tag rn-2026-04-02 --traffic 5%
```
Emergency fallback (ops playbook):
```
/deploy set-traffic eu-1 0% --target model:v2.0.9 --reason "canary rollback"
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary rn-2026-04-02 for eu-1 at 2026-04-02T00:30:00Z; queued by marta. Reply "ACK" to confirm standby.

devansh: ACK. Monitoring dashboards + alerts configured.

kai: ACK. I'll ramp at +10m if no alerts.

marta: One-line internal blurb to post ~30m before: suggestion?

devansh: Suggest: "Canary rn-2026-04-02: model v2.1.3 -> 5% EU, ramp to 20% if healthy. Oncall: infra/devansh, eng/kai. Rollback if >1.5% errors or p95 >1500ms."

marta: Good. I'll update RN doc, queue internal announce, and trigger deploy-bot 30m prior. Tagging @eng-oncall and @ops.

lia: Legal signed off.

marta: Thanks all 97 scheduling pre-flight ping now. :rocket:
